flows.name: Procurement Negotiation
flows.description: 6-step HITL negotiation: AI Buyer (Gemini) vs AI Supplier (Claude)

steps.action: Human drafts Material Request Quote — selects SKUs, quantities, desired prices
Gemini Buyer Agent proposes counter-offer with 3-5% volume discounts per SKU
Claude Supplier Agent generates fulfillment proposal, reviews discounts SKU-by-SKU
Human toggles SKU accept/decline. WorkflowEngine generates contracts, decrements inventory.
Gemini compiles markdown negotiation report for AI Auditor chatbot

flows.name: Article Quality Loop
flows.description: Gemini writes → Claude scores 1-10 → auto-retry below threshold

steps.action: User submits URLs, selects platform (Blog/LinkedIn/Instagram/X) and content mode
Gemini researches URLs and drafts platform-specific article via SSE stream
Claude reviews: score 1-10, summary + improvement suggestions
If score < 7: Gemini regenerates with Claude feedback (max 2 retries)
Final article saved. SSE done event with final score and attempt count.

flows.name: CV Generation Pipeline
flows.description: Evidence-grounded 2-stage AI CV with ATS optimization

steps.action: User uploads resume (PDF/DOCX), pastes profile links, enters target role + JD
Gemini 2.5 Pro analyzes all evidence → research_summary + ats_keywords JSON
Claude Opus generates professional CV Markdown from evidence + Gemini profile
ATS Optimizer scores CV vs job description (0-100), identifies missing keywords
5 formats: HTML CV, Markdown, JSON profile, ATS report, research summary

flows.name: Interview Coach Session
flows.description: 3-agent parallel question generation and evaluation via SAP AI Core

steps.action: User enters company, job title, JD, experience, interview type
GPT-4 analyzes company context, generates 6 base questions
Claude refines Q1-3 in parallel with Gemini refining Q4-6
All 3 agents evaluate each answer simultaneously (asyncio.gather)
Consolidated feedback + per-agent scores. Session persisted as JSON.

flows.name: Strategy Multi-Agent Analysis
flows.description: 4 specialized AI agents analyze strategy documents in parallel

steps.action: User uploads PDF/DOCX/PPTX, selects mode, optional extended thinking toggle
Claude: Strategy Architect — deep structural analysis, 12K token thinking budget
Gemini: Cost Challenger — cost, implementation, turnaround perspective
GPT-5.3: Validator — checklist, risk flags, missing evidence
GPT-5.4: Synthesizer — final Markdown merging all 3 agent outputs

flows.name: Daily Magazine Generation
flows.description: RSS feeds → Gemini enrichment → Claude editorial curation → HTML magazine

steps.action: User selects 1-5 tech sources (HN, TechCrunch, Wired) and clicks Generate
Gemini 2.0 Flash enriches each story: summary, key facts, applies_to_me, category
Claude Sonnet 4 curates top 10: headlines, decks, body, pull quotes, 10 spread styles
HTML magazine rendered with TOC, 10 visual spreads, SEO metadata, JSON-LD
Playwright PDF export, SMTP email delivery + attachment, LinkedIn post generation

flows.name: Energy Data Quality
flows.description: AI quality detection, lineage tracing, automated remediation across 35k records

steps.action: Data Quality Lab scans 7 datasets (35k records) for NULLs, outliers, schema violations
Gemini 2.5 Pro traces quarantined records through 5-stage ETL pipeline
SVG lineage diagram: Acquisition → Validation → Cleansing → Transformation → Lakehouse
Auto-fix: normalize nulls, abs() negatives, fix invalid statuses → saved to processed/

flows.name: NL-to-SQL Chat
flows.description: Natural language → LangGraph ReAct agent → SQL execution → markdown response

steps.action: User fills DB credentials (PostgreSQL/MySQL). SQLAlchemy engine stored in session registry.
LangGraph ReAct agent (claude-sonnet-4-6) instantiated with 3 database tools
Agent: schema introspection → table definitions → SQL construction → execute
Markdown response with syntax-highlighted SQL and formatted result tables

flows.name: SoW Generation and Export
flows.description: AI-powered Statement of Work from project context with Word/Excel export

steps.action: User defines project, creates tasks in dual-grid Planner (metadata + Gantt timeline)
SchedulingEngine: topological sort, critical path, weekend-aware Gantt date calculations
Claude 4.7 Opus generates SoW: Background, Scope, Deliverables, RACI Matrix
Export to Word (.docx) or Excel (.xlsx with live formulas, color-coded Gantt)
Auto-save every 2 min: project drafts + SoW drafts stored separately

flows.name: Skill Generation and Deploy
flows.description: Natural language → SKILL.md → Claude Code CLI auto-sync + .zip download

steps.action: User selects platform (Anthropic/Gemini/Azure) and describes skill in natural language
Selected LLM generates SKILL.md: YAML frontmatter + markdown sections
If Anthropic: auto-synced to .claude/skills/ for Claude Code CLI integration
Second LLM call generates usage notes. Test cases generated and executed.
Download as .zip (SKILL.md + README + LICENSE) for Claude.ai upload

flows.name: DOCX Vectorization
flows.description: DOCX hierarchical chunking pipeline producing Milvus-ready VectorRecords for RAG

steps.action: User uploads .docx. python-docx extracts paragraphs with heading hierarchy (h1-h6).
Optional: Azure OpenAI gpt-4o generates captions + OCR markdown for images
Hierarchical chunking: section-level (heading breadcrumbs) + paragraph-level
VectorRecords: embedding_text prefixed with breadcrumb path for semantic search
ProcessResponse: paragraphs + tables + images + chunks + Milvus-ready vector_records
